definitions.explanation: The premier professional basketball league in North America, featuring the world's top players.

examples.japanese: NBA⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧NBA⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ことだ。

examples.english: The NBA Finals are held every year in June.

notes:
NBA stands for "National Basketball Association," the top professional basketball league in North America. In Japanese, read as えぬびーえー.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- NBA⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧ (NBA player)
- NBAファイナル (NBA Finals)
- NBA⟦ドラフト→ドラフト：30282_dorafuto⟧ (NBA Draft)
- NBA⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧ (official NBA)
- NBAオールスター (NBA All-Star)

PRONUNCIATION:
Like most English-origin acronyms in Japanese, each letter is pronounced individually using the Japanese reading of the English letter names: エヌ・ビー・エー.

CULTURAL NOTE:
The NBA has grown in popularity in Japan, especially with Japanese players like {八村|はちむら}{塁|るい} and {渡邊|わたなべ}{雄太|ゆうた} playing in the league. NBA⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧ (NBA broadcasts) are available on Japanese streaming services.
